name: el-pato-de-la-suerte
description: Web app para apartar números de sorteos (00–99) con ruleta diaria y panel privado.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,publico,panel -c green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @pato/api" "npm run dev -w @pato/web-public" "npm run dev -w @pato/web-admin"
scripts.tipos: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web-public && tsc -p apps/web-admin
scripts.verificar: npm run tipos && npm run pruebas
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pato/web-public && npm run build -w @pato/web-admin
